title: Insulin Pump Program Authorization Reference: Covered Rate of a Denied Line
content:
For a non-covered item charge on an Insulin Pump Program, the covered rate of the denied line follows the authorization grant the line drew on:

| Grant the denied line drew on | Effect on the standard covered rate |
|---|---|
| a payer prior authorization | replaced with its units authorized times 30, divided by the days its span covers with both ends included, rounded down |
| a grant resting on the written order itself, with an over-limit justification record dated in the 12 months before today on file | replaced with the written order's quantity per 30 days |
| any other grant | the standard covered rate stands |

The span of a prior authorization runs from its valid-from date through its valid-through date, both days counted. The over-limit justification record is a clinical record received for the program whose recorded purpose is over-limit justification, dated by its visit date. A record counts as in a number of months before today when its date is later than the same day of the month that many months before today, so a record dated exactly that many months before today is outside the window.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Prior authorization for 270 units valid for a span of 365 days: 270 multiplied by 30 is 8,100; divided by 365 is 22.19, rounded down to 22 per 30 days.
- Written-order grant for an order of 15 per 30 days, with an over-limit justification record dated 5 months before today: replaced with 15 per 30 days.
- Written-order grant whose only over-limit justification record is dated exactly 12 months before today: outside the window, so the standard covered rate stands.
